d: Our ambition is to set a standard of excellence when it comes to serving the open source ecosystem. This is your chance to be a part of that as a Community Engineer at Canonical.
We are building community management at scale. We have multiple positions available, at different seniority levels.
All applications and candidates are handled through this single entry point.
To improve your chances of success in this application, read our advice on how to get a job at Canonical.
The role of a Community Engineer

The Community team at Canonical enables community leaders and participants to get things done, co-ordinating with Canonical teams and ensuring that community processes are efficient and well run. We don't do the work of the community, but we facilitate that work to ensure that energetic and ambitious community members with their own vision of open source can benefit from the work Canonical does and bring their own flavor of Ubuntu into being, to meet the needs and express the interests of their community. You will play a key role in designing, executing, and scaling initiatives that foster a thriving community.
This is an exciting opportunity for a technically proficient person who is passionate about open source software, Linux, and sustainable community building.

In this role, you will support community initiatives with your technical skills and strong organizational skills. You work hand in hand with developers to smooth processes and integrate community plans with Canonical plans for maximum impact. You can encourage and facilitate the creation of new technical projects that enhance the community contribution experience, and you represent community interests to Canonical teams. You will lead complex, multi-disciplinary programs from conception through launch, working closely with Developer Relations engineers, technical authors, product managers, marketing teams, engineering teams, and external partners.

You will support and engage with volunteer developers in the Ubuntu community, addressing their concerns and helping them to create successful tools. You will help to ensure their success and the overall autonomy and sustainability of projects.

You will provide the content and technical support to ensure the community stays engaged and informed. This will include regular blog and social media posts about community initiatives, events, accomplishments, and collaborative efforts between Canonical and the Ubuntu community.

You will communicate effectively with developers and software engineers and represent not only the Ubuntu community but Canonical as a contributor to the wider Linux ecosystem. Our team attends conferences and expos, and talks about technical community projects and their development processes.
Location: These are fully remote roles, open to candidates across the globe.
What your day will look like
Write high quality content to promote and support community initiatives
Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions to community problems
Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks for internal and external events
Potential opportunity to travel more if you wish
Engage with the Ubuntu community through Discourse, Matrix, social media, conferences, etc.
Represent Ubuntu via speaking engagements at events and conferences
Support the engagement by Canonical teams into the open source ecosystem
What we are looking for in you
You love technology and working with brilliant people
You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
You have experience with developer tools and open source projects
You have a clear public record of accomplishments (talks, blog posts, GitHub, X, etc.)
You have interest and experience with some of the following: Ubuntu Linux - kernel or userspace, DevOps, software development, testing and QA, package management, container technology
You can work autonomously and assume full ownership of objectives as needed
You can be flexible with your time and enjoy working with new technology in a fast-paced environment
You are experienced working with open source communities and understand the workflow of volunteer contributors
You have experience in (technical) program management and have excellent organizational, communication and interpersonal skills
q: Examples of contributions to the Ubuntu Community
Experience with contributing to open source projects

d: Riyadh Air (RX), headquartered in the Saudi Capital, is the new national airline that’s shaping the future of flying. It seeks to lead the aviation industry by transforming Saudi Arabia into a global aviation and trade hub – a digitally native airline that will connect the kingdom to more than 100 destinations.
Are you passionate about leading crew logistics that keep operations running smoothly across a fast-moving global network?

This role is central to planning and overseeing crew logistics across accommodation, ground transport, positioning travel and visas. It ensures reliable, cost-effective support for crew and operational teams across normal and disrupted operations.

A core part of the role is setting logistics standards, procedures and contingency plans across the network. This includes supporting new routes, training activity, approved business travel and wider Flight Operations logistics requirements.

Working closely with Crew Operations, Crew Planning, Flight Operations, Ground Operations and stations, the role acts as the central logistics contact for day-to-day coordination. It also leads the Logistics Coordinators, manages rostering for 24/7 coverage and maintains high booking accuracy.

With responsibility for disruption response, this position supports delays, cancellations, diversions, repatriation and other irregular operations. It ensures timely information flows to crew and operational stakeholders when fast, accurate decisions matter most.

In addition, the role focuses on supplier performance, cost control and data integrity. This includes monitoring service levels, supporting supplier reviews, reconciling expenses and keeping records and invoices accurate and audit-ready.
Your leadership in crew logistics will directly strengthen operational resilience, service reliability and the seamless support behind every journey we operate.
q: High school qualified or equivalent, you will demonstrate at least 5 years of experience in airline operations, crew logistics, hotel or ground transport operations.
Your background includes proven experience supervising or mentoring a team in a 24/7 operational environment and managing crew logistics within a large airline setting.

You will bring strong knowledge of crew management systems, crew travel and accommodation coordination, supplier performance monitoring, cost and invoice control, aviation regulations including General Authority of Civil Aviation (GACA) and International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) standards, along with excellent organisational skills, sound judgment, attention to detail and the ability to stay composed in a fast-paced environment.
This is your opportunity to shape the future of air travel. Bring your best and show us why you can own this position within Riyadh Air.

d: STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Math) Global Power+ Graduate Program
Are you ready to shape the future of sustainable energy?

The STEM Global Power+ Graduate Program is our flagship early career rotational program. It covers 13 different countries and is still growing (Brazil, Canada, China, India, Italy, Japan, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Poland, Sweden, Switzerland, United Kingdom, United States, and Vietnam), so you’ll be a member of an expanding global network. This opportunity exposes high potential graduates to different roles and experiences across various Business Units and Functions in Hitachi Energy. The program offers a unique, learning and career development experience. The program will jumpstart your career with a truly unique journey that will take you across (3) six-months long rotations (18 months in total). Focused on projects that broaden your skillset, each rotation will be within a different segment of our business, and you will choose each assignment area. You will join us as a full-time employee, and from day one in the program, you will be in the driver’s seat of your own career journey. Our offering is perfect for you if you are looking to fast-track your leadership potential and gain a well-rounded business acumen that will enable you to step into professional life.

The program will begin on 1st November 2026 The first six-months rotation will be possible in our locations in Saudi Arabia: [Riyadh / Damaam/ Jeddah). The second or third rotation may be done abroad, depending on your chosen project and the availability of business opportunities.
